variables.description:
Retrieves a collection of entities, utilizing a cache service.
This function now accepts a single options object for its parameters.

* @param {object} options - The options for the data request.
* @param {number} [options.page] - The page number for pagination.
* @param {number} [options.limit] - The number of records per page.
* @param {string} [options.query] - The query string for filtering.
* @param {boolean} [options.clearCache] - Flag to clear the cache before fetching.
* @param {string} [options.entity] - The entity type to fetch.
* @param {string} [options.apiType] - The API type to use ('crm' or 'auth').
* @returns {Promise<object>} A promise that resolves with the fetched data object { entities, total, totalFiltered }.
